message: I have a friend who panics at the first sign of storm clouds. Bless her heart, she once called me in a tizzy because the weather app predicted a rain shower. I just laughed and reminded her that a little rain never hurt anyone—and that sometimes it’s nice to cozy up with a cup of tea while the storm passes. It's all about keeping a level head and being prepared, but not letting the weather steal your joy. What’s your favorite way to ride out a storm? ☕
